units: mm; footprint coordinates are top view at component rotation 0 degrees
scope: Local component selections and PCB geometry only; retain all R2 pin numbers and electrical nets. No purchase or production qualification is implied.

layout_constraints.isolation_gap_applies_to: All top/bottom copper, pads, vias and polygons between BUS and LOGIC; U2's manufacturer land-pattern throat is the limiting 3.8 mm gap. Copper must not cross beneath either isolation component.

assembly_clearance_mm.note: Engineering assembly allowances, not dimensions quoted from the manufacturers. Preserve solder access to SMD electrolytics and module headers.

under_module_exclusions: RF antenna zone and its keepout
module.antenna_keepout: Keep all carrier copper on both layers, traces, vias and components away from the antenna projection; prefer an antenna end overhanging the carrier outline. Use the verified Nologo module outline/antenna metadata, not ESP32 IC dimensions.
module.usb_access: At rotation 180 USB points toward -Y; reserve connector and cable mating space.

compact_placement.note: Feasibility starting points provided by parent layout, not verified collision-free placement. BUS is left and LOGIC right. U2 secondary remains right; rotating U1 180 degrees places its BUS pins left.

can: No 120 ohm termination on this NMEA drop board.
Place D3 and L1 close to the cable entrance, minimize unprotected CAN traces and TVS return inductance.
Keep CANH/CANL together through the protection/choke/transceiver path; preserve TDK winding pin pairs 1-4 and 2-3.
thermal: Retain TPS7B6950 in SOT-223 with its pin-4 tab connected to GND_BUS.
Reserve a broad GND_BUS copper area on both layers around U3, stitch with thermal vias, and keep it clear of LOGIC isolation corridor.
Do not treat TI JEDEC 4-layer theta-JA as achieved on this compact two-layer board.

power_review.preserve_u2: RECOM R3M-2405S/SMD, input 9-36 V, 5 V 600 mA output, 3 W
power_review.minimum_input_limitation: 9 V minimum is specified at U2 input pins. Fuse, MOSFET and filter losses mean operation/startup at exactly 9 V at J1 is not guaranteed. Measure worst-case startup and Wi-Fi peaks; do not silently claim a 9 V connector minimum.
power_review.rejected_silent_substitution: R3M-1205S/SMD has a 4.5-18 V input range and is not a drop-in solution while retaining the present 20 V TVS and transient assumptions.

regulator_example.explanation: This dominant-bus maximum is a conservative thermal corner, not average operating draw. Theta-JA reference gives about 52 C rise only on its stated test board; the new board needs measured or simulated thermal verification.

power_review.ldo_output_capacitor_requirement: TI specifies 2.2-100 uF effective output capacitance with 0.001-2 ohm ESR. Verify C3 capacitance after DC bias and temperature; retain local ceramic bypassing.
power_review.u2_derating: RECOM specifies full load only up to 71 C ambient and 105 C maximum case. Confirm actual load and enclosure temperature.
open_qualification_items: Thermal behavior at maximum intended ambient, input voltage and CAN duty cycle
ESP32 Wi-Fi startup/peak load and 3.3 V regulator behavior of the fitted SuperMini revision
Capacitor ripple and input-filter stability during startup/load changes
TVS/fuse coordination and system transient test
EMC, CAN integrity and isolation verification on assembled board
